title: KS-1336: Downgrade the per-tenant database parent from High, or keep it High?
bluf: Every tenant shares one database today; isolation is a tenant_id column plus fail-closed RLS, and the per-tenant-DB path exists but is switched off. This ticket is a parent for five blocked tickets and builds nothing. You ruled option (c) on KS-1304 (2026-09-26 07:19): leave it until per-tenant databases are actually planned, with the note 'start planning the database'. The docs correction merged (#1286). The unresolved fork (build a dedicated-DB tier or delete the dormant path) turns on whether a named customer or contract needs physical separation, which the ticket does not say (unverified).
